utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Do you know the exact location and start time for the repair drive? I’m trying to find the closest spot to the school pickup route.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I don’t have the exact spot or start time yet, but I’m gathering those details now and will send them along as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa—just send me the location and start time when you have them, and I’ll figure out the closest route.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I’m glad someone’s coordinating it. I’ll ask around and send along any repair requests I hear.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word, and if you hear anyone with repair requests or spare hand tools, extension cords, or bike parts, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll ask around and pass anything along if I hear about repair requests or extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey. I’m keeping track of supplies, so the more folks know, the better.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense—I’ll spread the word a bit more. If anything specific comes up, just let me know and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey—I appreciate that. I’ll let you know if we need anything specific, and I’ll keep tallying the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help out; just tell me what needs fixing and where to bring it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren. Could you tell me exactly what needs fixing and where I should bring it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ve got a few broken things to sort out, and I’ll bring them by once I’ve made a proper list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I still need the school schedule first so I can pick a good time for the repair drive. If you have it, send it over and I’ll coordinate around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I don’t have the school schedule on me right now, sorry—I’ve been a bit out of it. I’ll send it over as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No worries — send it when you find it, and I’ll line up a time for the repair drive around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks, Sam—let’s start with the tool table by the shed, and then we can tackle the first repairs together.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus. I’d be grateful for any help with the small fixes around my place.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Of course, Uli — I can help with the small fixes. Just show me what needs doing first, and we’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check for any sign-up sheets or posted pickup times when I’m out later today, and I’ll let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good—please let me know once you check. If the organizer has a pickup time, I can plan to bring the wrench set then.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do—I’ll look for the pickup time and any sign-up sheet when I’m out, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. I’ll start with the leaky stuff and the long-standing problems, then we can see who needs help most.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep passing along any updates about the repair drive and make sure folks know when it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll keep my list handy and wait for your updates.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can get started on the tool sign-out and help with the first few repairs. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great — start with the leaky stuff and the repairs folks have been mentioning most. If you want, I can ask around and point you to the biggest needs.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll start with the leaky stuff and the most-mentioned repairs. If you hear of anything urgent, send them my way and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d like to confirm the pickup time with the organizer first, and then we can check whether Leo’s bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, so it’s still on — just waiting on the pickup time and tools confirmation, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, exactly — once we know the pickup time, we can sort the tools too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — I can help sort the donations and hand out supplies when folks arrive. What do you need me to do first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Start with the donations and supplies, then help where needed when people arrive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll start with the donations and supplies, then jump in wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — that would be a big help. See you at the repair drive, and let me know if you think of anyone else handy.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I think of anyone else handy. I’m still not 100% on the exact details, but I believe it’s at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds right — thanks, Bo. I’ll confirm the exact details, and see you at the community center for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—I’ll make that list and bring it by once I’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect—bring it by whenever you’re ready, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane. I’ll get it organized and stop by soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I still need the school schedule first so I can line up a time for the repair drive. Once I have it, I’ll coordinate the closest spot and donation hours.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — once you have the school schedule, I can help line up the best time. If you find the repair drive details too, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I’ll check the school schedule first, and if I get the repair drive details too, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, that’s still on the list. I’m handling the loose gate latch and the porch step.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Leo — I can round up the tools and get them set out for anyone who needs them. Just let me know if you want me to start on something else after that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus. Start with the tools, and after that maybe help with the porch step if you’ve got time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help with the tool sign-out and get started on the first repairs. Just point me to where you want me to begin.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, Sam — please start with the urgent repairs first, and I’ll send you the current list with tool sign-out details right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it — I’ll start with the urgent repairs and keep an eye out for the tool sign-out details. Send the list when you’re ready, and I’ll get going.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please do—just make sure they know it’s for the repair drive and not a regular block meetup.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course — I’ll make sure to say it’s for the repair drive. Thank you for checking.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Uli—could you also tell me what items we’re hoping people bring, so I can keep the details straight?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll tell everyone to check their sheds and garages right away. We’ll get those hand tools, extension cords, and bike parts in no time!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn—that’ll help a lot. Send them my way for supplies, and I’ll keep a running list of what comes in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do, Cleo—I’ll send folks your way and keep spreading the word about hand tools, extension cords, and bike parts.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—I'll check with the organizer about the pickup time and ask Leo about the tools. Just tell me when you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mina. Let’s wait on the organizer’s reply, and then I can tell you a time once we know the pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good—just let me know as soon as you hear back, and I’ll be ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, Kira—come by later and let me know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so it’s still on — when do you want the drop-off to happen?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Whenever works best—I'll be out running errands, so just let me know the time and I’ll keep an eye out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries, Jules—we’re still getting organized, but I’ve already told a few folks about the repair drive. I’ll keep spreading the word and let everyone know once we’ve got a firm time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good, Vik—I can help spread the word too once you have the time set. I’ll make sure everyone knows it’s for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules—that’d be a big help. I’ll let you know as soon as the time’s set, and then we can get the word out together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help out; just tell me what needs fixing and where to bring it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—right now they could really use hand tools, extension cords, and any spare bike parts folks aren’t using. Tell everyone to check their sheds and garages!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—I’ll spread the word and check my shed too. I’ll bring anything useful over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — that would help a lot. See if you can bring the tools, and I’d really appreciate you asking around for any handy folks too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can ask around too, and I’ll bring what tools I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be wonderful, Rey — thank you. Any tools you can bring and any handy folks you can point my way will really help the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, that helps a lot. If you can confirm the exact location and start time, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t got the exact spot or start time yet, but I’ll ask around and pass it along as soon as I hear. Thanks for being patient.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Nell. I appreciate you checking—just let me know when you find the exact location and start time.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
